name: mailio
listed_description: mailio is a cross platform C++ library for MIME format and SMTP, POP3 and IMAP protocols.
reason: README (11.8 KB) and repo page have no benchmark, timing or performance claim; no comparison against libcurl, vmime or any other mail library. Search found no third-party benchmark that includes it. Library is Boost.Asio-based with MIT licence, 485 stars, last commit 2026-09-23.

name: MQTT-C
listed_description: A portable MQTT C client for embedded systems and PCs alike.
reason: README emphasises portability and a two-file footprint under 2000 lines; no throughput, latency or size numbers and no comparison against Paho or Mosquitto clients. WebSearch for a third-party MQTT-C vs Paho benchmark returned only broker benchmarks (altoroslabs collection, mqtt-stresser) with no MQTT-C row. MIT, 896 stars, last commit 2022-10-27.

name: nghttp3
reason: README only says it optionally uses AVX2 (-mavx2) 'to optimize its performance'; no numbers and no comparison against another HTTP/3 or QPACK library. Found benchmarks measure whole QUIC stacks or curl backends, not nghttp3 alone: icing/blog curl-h3-performance.md compares curl builds with ngtcp2, quiche and OpenSSL QUIC with figures only as images and states ngtcp2 and quiche are roughly identical; the KIT QUIC throughput papers (doc.tm.kit.edu, publikationen.bibliothek.kit.edu) cover ngtcp2 transport, not the nghttp3 layer, and were not opened. MIT, 1.1k stars, last commit 2026-09-17.
